findings.title: Unescaped embed URL interpolated into stored raw HTML footer enables stored XSS
findings.body: The footer is built as `#{url}` with the URL unescaped, and the result is saved as a raw_html post. `Post#cook` returns raw for raw_html posts and nothing sanitizes it, so any quote in the URL breaks out of the attribute. The URL reaches this code from the `embed_url` query parameter of `/embed/best` via TopicRetriever, which only checks the host. A URL such as `http:///?x='onmouseover='alert(1)` passes URI parsing (apostrophes and `=` are legal in the query), and the remote returns 200 for any existing path. An anonymous visitor can therefore plant an event handler in a topic that every reader, including forum users on the Discourse origin, will execute. Escape the URL (e.g. CGI.escapeHTML / ERB::Util.html_escape) in both the attribute and the text, or build the link with Nokogiri.

findings.title: raw_html cook method permanently disables sanitization for every later edit
findings.body: `cook` returns the raw string whenever cook_method is raw_html, and before_save re-cooks on every update. Nothing resets cook_method, so any edit to an imported post, by any editor, is stored as cooked HTML with no PrettyText sanitization and with the `after_post_cook` plugin filters skipped. The flag was meant for trusted feed/readability imports but is not scoped to the import path. Restrict raw_html to creation by the importer, or re-cook through PrettyText on updates.

findings.title: Retrieval throttle keyed on the full URL can be bypassed to amplify remote fetches
findings.body: The 60-second throttle key is `retrieved:#{@embed_url}`, which includes the query string. Anonymous visitors can vary the query on each request and get a fresh key every time, so each request triggers an outbound fetch of the embeddable host. With feed polling enabled, each job also runs a full RSS poll and re-imports every feed item. EmbedController enqueues `retrieve_topic` for any embed_url before the host is validated (embed_controller.rb line 15), so garbage URLs also create jobs. Validate the host in the controller before enqueueing, and throttle per host or per normalized URL.

findings.title: Post-commit jobs and publishes run inside the outer Topic.transaction
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import wraps PostCreator.create in Topic.transaction. PostCreator#create calls enqueue_jobs (process_post, feature_topic_users) and publishes to MessageBus and TopicTrackingState before the outer transaction commits. PostCreator's own comment says jobs must be enqueued after commit. A Sidekiq worker can therefore run process_post before the post is visible. Separately, the check-then-create (`TopicEmbed.where(...).first` then `create!`) races with a concurrent import of the same URL (feed poll vs. retrieve_topic). The unique index blocks the duplicate row, but the RecordNotUnique error is unhandled and the rolled-back topic has already been announced. Move the import outside the enclosing transaction or defer enqueues with after_commit, and rescue the unique violation.

findings.title: Scheme check uses ^ which matches at any line start
findings.body: `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` passes if any line of the string starts with http(s)://, so `"javascript:alert(1)\nhttp://x"` is accepted. The value is then written into the footer href and stored as embed_url. Use `\A` (and the same change in PollFeed's `url !~` check, poll_feed.rb line 33).

findings.title: Protocol-relative URLs are rewritten into broken same-site paths
findings.body: `href.start_with?('/')` is true for protocol-relative URLs like `//cdn.example.com/x.png`. The `sub(/^\/+/, '')` then strips both slashes, producing `http://host/cdn.example.com/x.png`. The same applies to img src (line 71). The comment says relative URLs are converted, but only root-relative paths are handled. Protocol-relative URLs should get only the scheme prefixed.

findings.title: Remote fetch has no timeout and reads the whole body into memory
findings.body: `open(url).read` uses open-uri defaults with no open or read timeout and no size cap. A slow or hanging embeddable host blocks the Sidekiq worker indefinitely, and a very large response is loaded entirely into memory. Set open_timeout and read_timeout and limit the body size.

findings.title: A feed item without content aborts the whole poll; String#scrub needs Ruby 2.1+
findings.body: `i.content` is nil when an RSS item has no content element, so `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError. The loop stops, so the remaining items are never imported. PollFeed sets `retry: false`, so the hourly job just fails until the feed changes. TopicRetriever calls the same code, so one bad item also fails an unrelated visitor's retrieval. In addition, String#scrub only exists on Ruby 2.1+, so on older Rubies this line fails for every item. Guard nil content (and nil title) and skip or fall back per item.

findings.title: Kernel#open used on an unvalidated admin-set URL
findings.body: `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` calls Kernel#open. feed_polling_url has no URL validation. On Ruby versions before 3.0, a value beginning with `|` is run as a shell command, and an arbitrary path is read as a local file. Use `URI.parse(url).open` (or validate the scheme first) so only http(s) is fetched.

findings.title: Stray `end if` in template is malformed and breaks the embed view
findings.body: `<%- end if %>` closes the if/else but then starts a modifier `if` that applies to the next emitted output statement. Depending on how the ERB handler terminates the statement, this either fails to compile (every /embed/best render then errors) or reorders the output so the logo link is evaluated as a condition. The intended terminator is `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: X-Frame-Options value ALLOWALL is not a defined value
findings.body: The only defined X-Frame-Options values are DENY, SAMEORIGIN and ALLOW-FROM. Browsers ignore ALLOWALL, so this header has no effect whatever the comment or the intent suggests. If framing from any origin is intended, remove the header and use CSP frame-ancestors. If the goal is to override a stricter app-wide default, this does not do that either.

findings.title: 'is 404 without an embed_url' does not test the missing parameter
findings.body: embeddable_host defaults to '', so the before_filter ensure_embeddable raises InvalidAccess before `params.require(:embed_url)` runs. The example passes because of the host check, not the missing parameter, and its name is wrong (the response is a 403-style access error, not 404). Stub a valid host and referer, then call `get :best` without embed_url to test what the name claims.

findings.title: create_table with force: true drops an existing topic_embeds table
findings.body: If topic_embeds already exists when this migration runs (partly migrated database, or a table created by an earlier revision of this branch), `force: true` drops it along with every embed-to-topic mapping. Once the mappings are gone, the next retrieval of each embedded article creates a duplicate topic. Remove `force: true`.

findings.title: Existing migration changed to force-drop top_topics
findings.body: This edits an already-merged migration to add `force: true`. For any database where top_topics exists when the migration runs, the table and its counters are dropped and then rebuilt. Migrations should not drop tables. Revert to the original, or guard with `table_exists?`.

findings.title: NOT NULL column with default rewrites the posts table
findings.body: On PostgreSQL before 11, `add_column ... default: 1, null: false` rewrites the whole posts table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, blocking reads and writes for the duration on a large forum. Add the column nullable, backfill in batches, then add the default and NOT NULL constraint.

findings.title: Disqus importer silently changes behaviour and drops --category
findings.body: This change is outside the stated embed scope and is not documented. The `--category` option is removed, so `-c` no longer works. The first post's created_at is no longer set. Each thread is now fetched live via TopicEmbed.import_remote instead of an offline import, so an unreachable page, a 404, or a nil t[:link] (open(nil) raises TypeError) now breaks or skips the import. Split this into its own change with a documented migration path.

findings.title: embed_url is varchar(255) with no length guard; longer URLs fail at insert
findings.body: `t.string :embed_url` becomes varchar(255) on PostgreSQL. The URL comes straight from the request query string, and TopicRetriever and TopicEmbed only check the host and presence. A URL over 255 characters makes TopicEmbed.create! raise StatementInvalid after the topic and post were created inside the transaction. The job fails, and the embed page keeps showing 'Loading' and re-enqueuing. Validate length in the model or the controller, or use a text column.

findings.title: cook_method option honoured with no permission check
findings.body: Setting cook_method to raw_html disables PrettyText sanitization for the post. Nothing in this diff restricts who may set it. If any controller passes request params or a user-supplied hash into PostCreator, any user can store unsanitized HTML. Confirm callers only pass server-chosen values, or restrict this option to the import path.

findings.title: Origin check is a substring match, not an origin comparison
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` passes whenever e.origin is a textual prefix of the forum URL. For discourseUrl `https://forum.example.com/`, an origin of `https://forum.example.co` passes. A page on such a domain can post discourse-resize messages and control the iframe height. Compare e.origin for equality with the origin parsed from discourseUrl.

findings.title: setnx followed by expire is not atomic; a crash leaves a permanent throttle key
findings.body: If the process dies or expire fails between `setnx` and `expire`, the key has no TTL. retrieved_recently? then returns true forever for that URL, so the embed can never be retrieved again without manual Redis cleanup. Use a single atomic SET with NX and EX options.

findings.title: Missing embed_by_username silently skips import, leaving visitors on a loading page
findings.body: If embed_by_username is unset or names no user, fetch_http returns without logging or raising. The embedding visitor sees 'Loading Discussion...' and the page reloads every 30 seconds indefinitely with no error for the admin. Validate the setting, or log the failure.

findings.title: poll_feed itself is untested; spec only covers the execute gating
findings.body: All examples only check whether execute delegates to poll_feed. Feed parsing, item-to-topic import, and the URL fallback are not exercised, which is why the nil-content crash in poll_feed.rb goes unnoticed. The file also requires an unrelated job (jobs/regular/process_post).
